turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick question. I was trying to find someone on the professional network today.
Sure, who are you looking for?
Patricija Žemaitytė. I checked and she actually has a LinkedIn profile.
Got it. Noted that she has a LinkedIn profile.
Also, did my package with the new HDMI cables arrive? The tracking said it was out for delivery.
I don't have access to your personal mail tracking, but usually 'out for delivery' means it should arrive today. Did you check the porch?
Yeah, they are there. Thanks. Also, is it going to rain this weekend? I want to go hiking.
The forecast for this weekend looks mostly sunny with a slight chance of showers on Sunday afternoon, but Saturday looks clear.
Lloyd, I'm updating my contacts. Can you help me categorize a few people?
Of course. Who do you want to start with?
Patricija Žemaitytė. She is a product manager at Oxylabs.
Okay, I've updated her record to show she is a product manager at Oxylabs.
Great. By the way, what's the status of the server migration ticket I opened yesterday?
It's currently marked as 'In Progress' by the dev team. They expect to finish the data sync by end of day.
Okay. And did you remember to order the restock of coffee beans?
Yes, the order for the dark roast beans was placed this morning. It should arrive by Thursday.
